constraints.ocl:
context CheckIn
inv: self.isOnline implies self.boardingPass <> null

context BoardingPass
inv: ((self.seat <> null) and (self.seat.oclIsTypeOf(Seat))) and (self.checkIn.booking.createdAt <> '')

context BoardingPass
inv: (self.seat <> null) and (self.gate <> null)

context Baggage
inv: self.weightKg >= 4 and self.weightKg <= 56

context Aircraft
inv: (self.seats->any(x | x.seatNo <> '') <> null) and (self.airline.oclIsTypeOf(Airline))

context Booking
inv: (self.baggages->collect(x | x.weightKg)->notEmpty()) and (self.bookingRef <> '' and self.bookingRef.size() > 0)

context Flight
inv: self.arrivalTime <> null implies self.departureTime <> null

context Flight
inv: self.arrivalTime <> null and self.departureTime <> null

context Flight
inv: self.departureTime <> null and self.arrivalTime <> null

context Flight
inv: self.departureTime <> null implies self.arrivalTime <> null

context Airline
inv: (self.aircrafts->one(x | x.registrationNo <> '')) and (self.flights->size() >= 2 and self.flights->size() <= 3)
